For a house call: the town or ZIP, inside the travel area
after_time: Nervous at the vet, or ever needed a muzzle?
Records from the last vet: upload them on the page, or the hospital asks for them

What's wrong, in the owner's own words, and since when
The last vet's name, and the records or the vaccine history (a rabies certificate)
Pet insurance: its name only (it pays the owner back)
The street address, for a house call
'I'm 18 or older and the pet's owner, or the owner named me'
The consent forms to read ahead: anesthesia, and a goodbye visit
For a goodbye visit: 'Has the pet bitten anyone in the last 10 days?', and the aftercare choice
intake_questions.never_asked: no diagnosis, test result or medicine name passes through the AI; the owner's own words about what's wrong are checked for danger, then kept on the secure page
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult: the pet's owner, or someone the owner names (a family member, a pet sitter, a rescue that fosters the pet); a teen sends it to a parent

stop: trouble breathing, or blue or pale gums
a possible poisoning: chocolate, rat bait, antifreeze, lilies for a cat, or someone's medicine
can't stand or walk, or collapsed
bloat signs: a swollen, hard belly, or retching with nothing coming up
bleeding that won't stop, or hit by a car
a cat straining to pee with nothing coming out
safety_and_stop_words.go_on: a sick or hurt pet with none of the stop words is booked as a sick or hurt exam, soonest times first; the AI adds: 'If it gets worse, or you see any of these signs, go to the emergency animal hospital now'. Simple first steps, the example practices' own: a small cut gets 'press a clean cloth on it'; a limp gets 'keep your pet quiet'; always 'never give a pet human medicine'. Nothing more: no advice on what's wrong or what to give
safety_and_stop_words.stop_action: No booking, and no wait for one. Rosie says: 'This needs a vet now. Go to the nearest emergency animal hospital. The one Lee Animal Hospital works with is open 24 hours.' It gives that hospital's name, address and number, from the owner's settings. For a possible poisoning, it also gives the pet poison line the owner named at sign-up, and says it may charge a fee. Rosie never judges how sick a pet is, and never says what's wrong.

prep: A dog on a leash, a cat in a carrier
Surgery or a dental cleaning: no food after midnight, water is OK, unless the vet says otherwise on the page
House call: the pet inside, in a quiet room

staff.skills: exams and vaccines (every vet); surgery and dental cleanings (only the vets who do them; here, Marcus); goodbye visits; house calls (here, Owen and Priya for Lee Mobile Vet, and Marcus for the hospital's vaccine visits at home); farm animals (here, Owen)
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each vet's own license, per state; vet techs only where the state's form credentials them; controlled-drug registrations where the state's form asks (a switch)
staff.supervision: vet techs and assistants work under a vet, as the state's rules set (a switch: a vet on site or reachable); anesthesia only with a vet on site
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs a goodbye visit for a pet the practice hasn't seen, same-day exams, estimates over $300 at the hospital and over $500 on a house call (a partner may OK house call prices), fees and refunds
staff.stand_in: another vet may take an exam or a vaccine visit; surgery moves only to another vet who does surgery, or to a new date; a goodbye visit moves to another vet only with the family's yes: with no answer, Sam calls the family, and nothing changes until then

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult: the pet's owner, or someone the owner names (a family member, a pet sitter, a rescue that fosters the pet); a teen sends it to a parent
children_and_age.minors_texts: a teen's request goes to a parent, who books

visit.check_in: at the hospital: the check-in code at the front desk; a surgery or dental drop-off: the code at the desk at drop-off, with a number to reach the owner and a pick-up window; at home: the code at the door
visit.done: the check-in code, READY and the pick-up, or DONE; the vet's notes stay in the practice's own records

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always: each vet holds their own active license from the state's veterinary board
license.who: each vet; each vet tech or assistant only where the state's form licenses, registers or certifies them; the practice too where the state issues a premises or hospital permit, and a mobile practice or unit its own permit where the state's form asks
license.ask: each person's license number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); the hospital's premises permit and the mobile practice's permit number from the owner, only where the state's form has them
license.insurance: liability insurance as the business says; shown as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
